note: Teach voice prompts (ADR-003). Written offline by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) from the trigger list and the constraints in content/prompts/candidates.md only; no child data. Gender-neutral: first-person plural, and praise adjectives attach to a noun (reading, answer, work), never to the child; fully vowelled MSA, never a word meaning wrong or mistake. All unreviewed until a specialist approves.

prompts.gloss: Let us begin!
Hello! Let us read together.
Let us learn something new.
Let us listen first, then read together.
Let us hear the word again.
We listen carefully, then repeat.
Wonderful reading!
Lovely work!
Excellent answer! Let us carry on.
Let us try again.
Let us read it together a second time.

prompts.text: مُحَاوَلَةٌ جَمِيلَةٌ! هَيَّا نُجَرِّبُ مِنْ جَدِيدٍ.
prompts.gloss: Nice attempt! Let us try once more.
Let us look at the dots.
How many dots do we see? And where are they?
The dots change the letter; let us count them.
The letter is emphatic; we say it with a heavy sound.

prompts.text: هَلْ نَسْمَعُ الْحَرْفَ ثَقِيلًا أَمْ خَفِيفًا؟
prompts.gloss: Do we hear the letter heavy or light?

prompts.text: نُفَخِّمُ الْحَرْفَ حَتَّى يَمْتَلِئَ بِهِ الْفَمُ.
prompts.gloss: We make the letter heavy until it fills the mouth.

prompts.text: لِنَنْظُرْ إِلَى الْحَرَكَاتِ فَوْقَ الْحُرُوفِ وَتَحْتَهَا.
prompts.gloss: Let us look at the vowel marks above and below the letters.

prompts.text: فَتْحَةٌ أَمْ ضَمَّةٌ أَمْ كَسْرَةٌ؟ هَيَّا نَنْظُرُ جَيِّدًا.
prompts.gloss: Fatha, damma or kasra? Let us look carefully.

prompts.text: الْحَرَكَةُ تُغَيِّرُ النُّطْقَ، هَيَّا نَقْرَأُ بِبُطْءٍ.
prompts.gloss: The vowel mark changes the sound; let us read slowly.
Let us find the letter in the word.

prompts.text: أَيْنَ الْحَرْفُ؟ فِي الْبِدَايَةِ أَمْ فِي الْوَسَطِ أَمْ فِي النِّهَايَةِ؟
prompts.gloss: Where is the letter? At the start, in the middle or at the end?

prompts.text: يَتَغَيَّرُ شَكْلُ الْحَرْفِ فِي بِدَايَةِ الْكَلِمَةِ وَوَسَطِهَا وَنِهَايَتِهَا.
prompts.gloss: A letter changes shape at the start, middle and end of a word.
We read a lot today, thank you!
We have finished! See you next time.
Wonderful work today, goodbye!
CONTROL - must be discarded: contains a word meaning 'mistake'.
CONTROL - must be discarded: masculine 'well done (you)'.
